subsection.title: Product Name
subsection.description: State the product, service, or feature name used throughout the document.

subsection.title: One-line Summary
subsection.description: Explain in one sentence who the product helps and what result it provides.
subsection.example: A workspace that helps product managers turn an early idea into a reviewable UI PoC through guided conversation.

subsection.title: Primary User
subsection.description: Identify the first user who directly experiences the problem and will use the PoC.

subsection.title: User Problem
subsection.description: Describe the concrete situation, friction, and consequence the user experiences today.

subsection.title: Solution Direction
subsection.description: Describe the product approach at the user-experience level without choosing an implementation.

subsection.title: Expected User Change
subsection.description: Describe what the user should be able to do, understand, or decide differently after using the product.
